]> 26/07/2026 7:04 Mostly sunny Sunday at Perisher.

Sunday's shaping up mostly sunny, with a top of 6 degrees and light westerly winds around 16km/h.

29 lifts are expected to spin today, but as always, keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop.

With 34 groomed runs across the resort, expect firm, fast conditions and hard-packed snow underfoot.

Leichhardt Park officially opened yesterday for the first time this winter, so grab your mates and get amongst it for some park laps.

If you're keen to try before you buy, today's your last chance to demo the latest gear from Faction and Dynastar. Head to the Mt Perisher Powder Inn between 9am and 3pm to say hello and put it through its paces.

The good times continue off the slopes too, with live music around the mountain all day: Will Clift at Jax Bar, Matty Rogers at Blue Cow, and DJ Bolta bringing the beats at the Red Bull Boom Box.

Have a great Sunday!
